Class I is treated the other way round on the same statements: both conditions do present class I, so a class-I peptide named under both stays ambiguous between them. The asymmetry between the two classes is the biology the paper reports, not a curation shortcut -- the parental cells present class I and do not present class II.

Treat these peptides as probable background rather than as evidence of HLA-II presentation.
